rootCause: The admission keeper still used ordinary background RPC scheduling for its canonical authority, pool and ticket-preparation reads. Four serialized admissions therefore incur background queue delays while replay/history remains active. Engine admission proofs also take 3.2-6.4 seconds under load. New candidate promotes only scoped admission reads to the existing foreground queue. This does not yet prove the eight-second target.
